kai: hey team :wave: day 1. need Console Env Panel access for onboarding: qa=admin to run flag smoke tests, prod=readonly to review runbooks AND read-only access to the feature-flag audit logs for post-mortem learning. who should i ping?
marta: welcome kai! :tada: open infra-permissions and include manager approval. note: audit-log access is gated separately (audit-viewers). add that group to the request.
kai: can someone paste the minimal ticket body i should use?
marta: here you go:
```
Title: Env panel + audit logs access - kai
Requester: kai
Manager: kevin
Environments: qa (admin), prod (readonly)
Additional access: audit-viewers (feature-flag logs)
Flags to touch: onboarding.*
Duration: 14 days
Purpose: onboarding tests + runbook & audit review
```
kevin: approved. adding note: kai will only toggle flags in qa and coordinate flips with me during demos.
infra-bot: tip: after infra processes the ticket, verify via Console -> avatar -> "My permissions" OR run:
`curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles | jq`
infra-bot: expected roles: `"env_panel": "admin"` in qa, `"env_panel": "readonly"` in prod, and `"audit_logs": "viewer"` if audit-viewers was granted. If not, reply here and tag @ops.
ops: infra granted QA admin and audit-viewers. Prod readonly pending SCIM sync; queued (ETA ~20m).
kai: filed ticket INF-8420 and attached manager approval. thanks all!
marta: once prod readonly lands i'll drop a short checklist for safe audit reads (where to find deployments, how to redact user ids).
